summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing an ASX Appendix 3Z final director's interest notice disclosing that Mark Cutifani ceased to be a director on 13 September 2026, following his last notice dated 19 March 2026. The notice reports nil relevant interests in Woodside securities, whether held directly or indirectly, and no interests in contracts. No price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. The exit is abrupt and board-level, making the departure itself the event; watch for successor appointment, board composition, and any strategic or governance follow-through.
